focus: Recover discovery after changing from Wi-Fi to an Android phone hotspot.
changes: Windows refreshes UDP multicast membership before every announcement and transmits through every active IPv4 adapter.
Android refreshes multicast membership every ten seconds and attempts hotspot adapters even when their multicast capability flag is inaccurate.
Stale adapter memberships are removed when the active network changes.

verification.name: Node test suite
verification.coverage: Includes a regression test that moves discovery from 192.168.1.20 to hotspot address 192.168.43.72.

verification.name: Android/Windows transport interoperability
verification.coverage: Mutual TLS, approval, direct transfers, reverse receiving, cancellation, integrity, and PC restart.

verification.name: APK signature and alignment
verification.result: passed: APK Signature Schemes v2 and v3

verification.name: Windows package and installer
verification.command: npm run package; npm run installer

verification.name: Packaged Windows UI workflow
verification.coverage: Renderer startup, selection, manual HTTPS registration, actual send/receive approval, history, and dark theme.

physical_device_boundary: Automated checks cannot prove multicast forwarding in a particular phone hotspot firmware. Install both 1.5.1 updates, connect the PC to the phone hotspot, wait up to ten seconds or press Refresh, and test one small file in each direction.
